items:
B-Side Seaside by Royal Destinations

Location: Seagrove Beach
Address: 32 Hickory Street

Details:
Searching for a 30A vacation home with Gulf views and a location just steps from the beach access and Seaside? Look no further than B-Side Seaside! This Seagrove Beach rental is nestled amongst the oak trees and features a hard to beat location! With the Hickory Beach Access just 171 feet away, guests can spend their days taking in the sounds of the waves. Those searching for 30A vacation rentals with private pools are sure to enjoy this one after a long day at the beach. There are plenty of dinner options to choose from all within a 5-minute walk of the home. For a romantic date night, head East to Surfing Deer and indulge in mouthwatering seafood options. For a family outing, venture West and decide between delicious pizza at Pizza Bar, tacos at Taco Bar, and various choices at the ever-popular Seaside airstreams. Be sure to make it back home in time to watch the sun set over the Gulf from the 3rd floor! On rainy days (or when the beach isn’t calling your name) guests of all ages are sure to enjoy the game room (located in the garage) complete with new epoxy flooring, a ping pong table, and corn hole. This Seagrove Beach vacation rental is sure to be your favorite 30A escape!

If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental.

Home Highlights:
-Distance to Beach Access: 171 Feet (1 Minute Walk)
-Distance to Seaside Community: 5 Minute Walk
-Beautiful Gulf View From 3rd Floor
-1 House back from 30A
-Beautiful view of Gulf from 3rd floor Master and Balcony
-New Refinished Hardwood Floors Throughout (New Epoxy Floor In Garage)
-New Game Room In Garage With Ping-Pong Table And Corn Hole Set
-Parking Spaces: 2 Spaces in Driveway and 1 Space in Garage
-Dining Accommodations: Table Dining for 8, Bar Seating for 3
-Coffee Maker Available
-Hanging tree lights in backyard for evening entertaining
-Propane Grill Available (Propane Provided)
-*Private Heated Pool:
*Pool heat is available for an additional $230 (pre-tax)
*The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees.
*Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay.

Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements:
Sleeps 14
5 Bedrooms | 3 Bathrooms

First Floor:
-Bedroom 1: King Bed with Large Shared Bath (Shower/Tub Combo)
-Bedroom 2: Twin over Queen Bunk with Shared Bath (Shower/Tub Combo)

Second Floor:
-Bedroom 3: Twin/Twin Bunk with Bath (Shower/Tub Combo)
-Kitchen / Living Area / Dining Area (1 Queen Pull Out Couch In Living Area)

Third Floor:
-Bedroom 4: King Bed, Pull Out Queen Sofa with Large Shared Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower)
-Bedroom 5: Queen Bed with Shared Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower)

Amenities Include:
-4 Adult Bikes

Please Note:
Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival.

Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
